title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027.

The route begins at The Pinnacle in Nashville and closes at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, with Radio City Music Hall in New York and two nights at Toronto's Massey Hall among the larger rooms on the itinerary. Rather than stretching across an entire season, the tour is concentrated into a month of shows through the United States and Canada.

The name Everything Begins plays on Young's "everything ends" tattoo, giving the tour a direct connection to the period she has just come through. She stepped away from touring in 2025, then returned to regular live work this year with two sold-out hometown shows at London's O2 Academy Brixton and a run of festival appearances. The new dates turn that return into her first full North American headline route since the break.

Young also comes back to the road with a Grammy and new music behind her. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the 2026 Grammy Awards, while "From Down Here" arrived in May as her first new single since *I'm Only F**king Myself*. Made with James Blake, the song gave the next phase of her career a new recording of its own rather than simply extending the life of the hit that introduced her to a much wider audience.

[youtube:-u9TRlZADmg]

The scale of the rooms is part of the story. Radio City Music Hall, two nights at Massey Hall and the Greek Theatre place Young in significantly larger headline settings than the clubs that framed her earlier US shows, while the compact routing keeps the focus on a clear return rather than an endless itinerary. It also gives the spring run a sense of progression without turning the announcement into a list of every stop.

Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. The tour opens in Nashville on April 6 and reaches Los Angeles on May 4.
